blocking_failures: hardcoded_solution: The solution (solve.sh) hardcodes the entire fixed source code of config_parser.c as a Python script that writes the corrected file directly, without inspecting the existing code to identify the bug. It generates the fixed source from scratch rather than deriving the fix through investigation of the existing code.
advice: test_deps_in_image: The Dockerfile installs pytest==8.3.4 via pip into the runtime image, but pytest is only needed for testing (test.sh installs its own version via uvx). Having pytest baked into the runtime image is unnecessary and violates the principle of keeping test-only dependencies out of the image.

oracle_investigates: The solution hardcodes the entire fixed config_parser.c source as a Python heredoc without first inspecting the existing source to locate the bug. It does not run the binary, examine outputs, or read the existing source files to diagnose the issue. The fix is pre-written based on author knowledge rather than derived from discoverable information.
